- Option A: 2026-11-18 16:00 UTC (08:00 PST / 17:00 CET / 01:00 JST) — favors EU + US, APAC rings late evening for Japan.
- Option B: 2026-11-19 14:00 UTC (06:00 PST / 15:00 CET / 23:00 JST) — later for APAC but still doable for some teams.
- Option C: 2026-11-20 09:30 UTC (01:30 PST / 10:30 CET / 18:30 JST) — early for US, mid-morning for EU, evening APAC (split session option).

If none of these work for Suresh/India leads, we can run a shorter EU/US demo and record a focused APAC session.

I've attached Proposed_demo_slots_UTC.xlsx and will prepare an updated calendar invite once you confirm preferred option.
